$comment: Catalog for the cross-model KV transfer serving demo. Local-only in practice:
control-plane.json admits only local/* targets, so the one hosted entry below is
never routed to. It exists because a catalog needs at least one model entry and
the echo stub answers for it when ROUNDHOUSE_FRONTIER_UPSTREAM is unset.
local_quality carries BOTH halves of the pair, by served model name, so the
router prices the source and the target at different qualities. The numbers are
placeholders on the 0..1 scale quality_prior is defined on; replace them with a
published index (CLAUDE.md: 'Cost and pricing data') before trusting a dashboard.
local_base_ttft_ms is the only source of that number now (no env var).
